svg.title: A true density and the exponential closest to it in Kullback-Leibler divergence
svg.desc: Left: a two-component truth with a tall spike near zero beside a flatter fitted exponential. Right: tail probabilities on a log scale, where the fitted model is far below the truth beyond about nine.
svg.text: The model the data pull you toward when no model is right
truth: nine parts in ten short-lived, one part in ten long-lived; model: a single exponential
Fitting by maximum likelihood matches what the truth rewards on average, which here is the mean; nothing makes it match a tail.
More data moves the fitted rate closer to 0.5263 and no closer to the truth.
